name: What is involved in the siding flashing repair process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the siding flashing repair process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The repair process typically begins with a thorough inspection to identify all points of failure and assess any hidden damage. Our team will carefully remove the old or damaged flashing and any affected siding. We then prepare the surface, ensuring it is clean and dry. New, appropriately sized flashing is installed, often with a weather-resistant barrier, using proper sealing techniques to create a watertight seal. Finally, any removed siding is reinstalled or replaced, and the area is cleaned. The goal is a durable, long-lasting repair that integrates seamlessly with your existing siding.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes inspection, removal of old flashing/siding, surface preparation, installation of new flashing with proper sealing, and siding reinstallation.
